record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, change only the causal readout blend from 0.8*h_t+0.2*m_t to 0.85*h_t+0.15*m_t, retaining the three-interaction pooling half-life. A smaller pooled contribution may reduce stale-interest interference without abandoning the pooling benefit. Exclude padding and future states, preserve final-real-position inference, and synchronize predictor metadata and writer. Keep embeddings, GRU topology, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, test whether reducing the causal pooled-state contribution from 20% to 15% reduces stale-interest interference. Retain the three-interaction half-life, padding exclusion, causal prefixes and final-real-position inference. Synchronize checkpoint metadata and the predictor writer; preserve all other settings and one GRU4Rec model per dataset.
